implementation.public_interface_change: promoteParameterCommand accepts optional insertion index; ViewerController::promoteParameter accepts index (-1 appends); CLI promote-parameter accepts optional nonnegative index. Insertion is part of the promotion command, not a second undo step. No new dependencies or node types.
